item.title: Hello World!
item.description:
Hello, reader! Welcome to my website, here I intend to write a little about geology and technology, as well as some other sub-areas that are of my interest. Here I intend to avoid topics that I don’t have mastery of, and even if I don’t, my basis will be referenced by people who have such expertise.

You are creating a website/blog at a time when many people, professionals, and influencers are leaving this type of platform. — You must be asking

item.title: About me
item.description: Hello world! My name is Gabriel Moura, I am a geology student and besides being passionate about the earth, its processes and its evolution, I have always been very interested in programming and more recently an interest in statistics, data science, and so on. in 2017, I started the geology course at the Instituto Federal do Rio Grande do Norte (IFRN), and even before finishing the course, I enrolled in the geology course at the Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Norte (UFRN).
